data.name: label7.Text
data.value:
You can send midi commands to your controller when some events occur.
When NOT in setup Buttons that are mapped to commands that toggle (i.e. command that have On or Off in their name ) the down event fires the first time the button is pressed, the up event fires the second time the button is pressed.
Example. To turn Hercules RMX right cue LED on when the button is down you would enter in the Button Down Event box: BX247F X=will be substituted with the correct channel value. All other values MUST be in hexedecimal. Only Midi short messages can be sent.
SS=Status YY=ControlId VV=Value C=channel. SSYYVV will send the current command back to the controller.

data.name: label5.Text
data.value:
To get started press a button or move a slider, knob or wheel on your controller.
Make sure you move sliders and knobs from end to end so that the full range of the control can be recorded.
When Prompted enter meaningful names for your controls, it will make mapping much easier!
